column1: # A row is one sense of one phrase. Pins are position=reading, and exist ONLY
# where a character reads differently from the corpus principal - so every pin
# marks a place a reader would otherwise guess wrong. Position, not glyph:
# 慢慢地走 repeats 慢, and two glyph-keyed pins could not be told apart.
# 东西 carries two senses that are not even read alike - dongxi for the object,
# dong-xi for the directions. It is sense 1 that shows 东 = east.

column3: to not have; there is not
to have something to rely on
to weigh out half a kilo
chariot, horse and cannon - the chess pieces
the pauses that punctuate a classical text
seen so often it is nothing new
the first month of the lunar year
a ge of rice - an old measure
to pass through; by means of
to spend; to get through (a time)
to size up; to guess at
to go on a business trip
at all; from the very start
to carry water on a pole
to go to someone for shelter
to cope with; to deal with
to carry water on a pole
at ease in mind and stout in body
